mapper.select: /* 반복 예방 목록 조회(등록순), 다음 예정일은 자동 추가한 케어 항목 기준 */ SELECT R.REPT_PRVNT_MNG_SN , R.CKUP_RCD_SN , R.REPT_PRVNT_ARTCL_CD , A.COM_CD_NM AS REPT_PRVNT_ARTCL_CD_NM , R.REPT_CYCLE_CD , Y.COM_CD_NM AS REPT_CYCLE_CD_NM , R.CYCLE_DRCT_INPT_DAY_CNT , R.BGNG_YMD , C.NXTM_PRNMNT_YMD FROM REPT_PRVNT_MNG R LEFT JOIN CARE_ARTCL C ON C.REPT_PRVNT_MNG_SN = R.REPT_PRVNT_MNG_SN AND C.DEL_YN = 'N' LEFT JOIN COM_CD A ON A.COM_CD = R.REPT_PRVNT_ARTCL_CD AND A.COM_CD_PRNT_SN IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN COM_CD Y ON Y.COM_CD = R.REPT_CYCLE_CD AND Y.COM_CD_PRNT_SN IS NOT NULL WHERE R.CKUP_RCD_SN = #{cond.ckupRcdSn} AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY R.REPT_PRVNT_MNG_SN

/* 검진기록들의 반복 예방 목록 조회(등록순) */ SELECT R.REPT_PRVNT_MNG_SN , R.CKUP_RCD_SN , R.REPT_PRVNT_ARTCL_CD , A.COM_CD_NM AS REPT_PRVNT_ARTCL_CD_NM , R.REPT_CYCLE_CD , Y.COM_CD_NM AS REPT_CYCLE_CD_NM , R.CYCLE_DRCT_INPT_DAY_CNT , R.BGNG_YMD , C.NXTM_PRNMNT_YMD FROM REPT_PRVNT_MNG R LEFT JOIN CARE_ARTCL C ON C.REPT_PRVNT_MNG_SN = R.REPT_PRVNT_MNG_SN AND C.DEL_YN = 'N' LEFT JOIN COM_CD A ON A.COM_CD = R.REPT_PRVNT_ARTCL_CD AND A.COM_CD_PRNT_SN IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN COM_CD Y ON Y.COM_CD = R.REPT_CYCLE_CD AND Y.COM_CD_PRNT_SN IS NOT NULL WHERE R.CKUP_RCD_SN IN #{sn} AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY R.REPT_PRVNT_MNG_SN

/* 반복 예방 조회 */ SELECT REPT_PRVNT_MNG_SN , PET_SN , CKUP_RCD_SN , REPT_PRVNT_ARTCL_CD , REPT_CYCLE_CD , BGNG_YMD , CYCLE_DRCT_INPT_DAY_CNT , DEL_YN , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT , RGTR_ID , MDFR_ID FROM REPT_PRVNT_MNG WHERE REPT_PRVNT_MNG_SN = #{reptPrvntMngSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
